items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: My daddy was. Your daddy was but not your mama. My mother. She was younger than him. My daddy was ten years old in slavery.

ctx.x: She was born in slavery times. The bass player.
My daddy was. Your daddy was but not your mama. My mother. She was younger than him. My daddy was ten years old in slavery. Ten years old.
I was going to ask her about the bass player there. Foster. Was he any relation to George? The one they called Pops Foster?
